pr.title: feat(config): comment_min_age_secs to settle edited comments
pr.body:
feat(config): comment_min_age_secs to settle edited comments

<!-- git-stk:description -->
Adds `general.comment_min_age_secs` (default 0 = off): hold a comment until it's at least this old before notifying, so a bot that posts a placeholder and edits it in place ("Claude Code is working…" → the finished review) settles to its final text and you get one accurate alert.

A too-fresh comment is skipped *and* left out of the snapshot's seen-set, so it re-derives next poll and emits its settled body then. `created_at`-based, so edits within the window are captured on the re-fetch. Threaded through `DiffContext` for GitHub and Gitea.

Closes #55.
<!-- /git-stk:description -->

<!-- git-stk:closes -->
Closes #55
<!-- /git-stk:closes -->

seed.mutation: missing call in one of two parallel paths
seed.patch:
diff --git a/crates/navi-notifier-forge/src/diff.rs b/crates/navi-notifier-forge/src/diff.rs
index 53ef786..867921e 100644
--- a/crates/navi-notifier-forge/src/diff.rs
+++ b/crates/navi-notifier-forge/src/diff.rs
@@ -398,12 +398,7 @@ fn build_snapshot(
             .collect(),
         // A held (not-yet-settled) comment is intentionally left unseen so it is
         // re-evaluated next poll, by which point its edits have landed.
-        seen_review_comments: data
-            .review_comments
-            .iter()
-            .filter(|c| is_settled(c.created_at.as_deref(), now, comment_min_age))
-            .map(|c| c.id)
-            .collect(),
+        seen_review_comments: data.review_comments.iter().map(|c| c.id).collect(),
         seen_issue_comments: data
             .issue_comments
             .iter()

expected.description: build_snapshot marks every review comment as seen without the is_settled filter the issue comments get, so with comment_min_age set a fresh review comment is held on this poll and then skipped as already seen on the next, and is never delivered.
